description:
Presenting a spacious Townhouse located in a sought-after North Carlisle development. This property features an open-plan dining kitchen family room on the ground floor, offering versatile living space. Additionally, a first-floor Living Room provides a tranquil rural view. The property comprises three generous bedrooms, a family bathroom, and an ensuite shower room for added convenience. Step outside to the generous rear garden, perfect for outdoor activities and relaxation. With ample parking and a garage, this home offers practicality and comfort. Situated near various amenities and public transport routes, this townhouse provides an ideal blend of convenience and tranquillity. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this stylish property in a desirable location. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and secure this property as your new home.

Directions Head north on Scotland Road, at Kingstown, follow the road signs towards Rockcliffe, turn left onto Crindledyke Lane, take the third left onto Fenwick Drive. Number 41 is located on the left hand-side.
